title: EduEval: A Hierarchical Cognitive Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Chinese Education
reasoning: The benchmark includes a dedicated 'Ethics' dimension as one of its six hierarchical levels (Memory, Understanding, Application, Reasoning, Creativity, and Ethics). It specifically evaluates LLMs on tasks such as moral judgment, ethical scenarios for primary to senior levels, and educational ethics judgments, making it a core component of the benchmarking effort rather than just a discussion of the authors' own ethical practices.
